authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES leftover-design work for DR-131 NT-1, NT-2, NT-3, NT-5, NT-6, NT-7, and NT-8 only. It does not add a DR-G* row, does not change required-now 19, does not close leftover-design, does not open D-056 Class A, does not SATISFY DR-131, does not edit file 08, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: State that those seven leftover classes have no live gate corpus, group them by kind, and propose — as candidate-not-adopted — later DR-G* obligations. This artifact does not add those rows and does not assign gate numbers.

basedOn.role: Measurement: NT-4 is discharged by named DR-133 classes. NT-1/2/3/5/6/7/8 remain leftover-design.

head: fb6ba1f07a487970e83a13b91562af6d73257ff7

classes.name: user-or-third-party-pack-refused
classes.inputVerbatim: An analyze request that names a pack other than opensip.preview.typescript.pack version 1, or supplies a user/third-party pack.
classes.passVerbatim: Request refused at admission. No evaluation.

classes.name: imperative-rule-refused
classes.inputVerbatim: A pack or contribution that is not declarative-only.
classes.passVerbatim: Refused at admission. ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT dependents stay excluded.

classes.name: missing-rung-not-success
classes.inputVerbatim: Required TypeScript semantic universe cannot be constructed.
classes.passVerbatim: Typed Coverage-indeterminate. Not authoritative success. No silent syntax fallback.
classes.residual: leftover-design: missing required rung is typed Coverage-indeterminate

classes.name: sarif-not-advertised
classes.inputVerbatim: A request or flag that advertises SARIF 2.1.0 for preview analyze.
classes.passVerbatim: Refused or not offered. D-077 drop stands.
classes.residual: leftover-design: preview analyze refuses or does not offer SARIF

classes.name: preview-result-not-sealed-run
classes.inputVerbatim: A consumer treats the preview terminal result as a sealed authoritative Run.
classes.passVerbatim: The contract forbids that label. No silent promotion.
classes.residual: leftover-design: preview result must not be labeled a sealed Run

classes.name: host-must-not-mint-verdict
classes.inputVerbatim: A host path that derives fail or warn other than from the core policyOutcome in CoreCompletion.
classes.passVerbatim: Refused. The only policy result is core-evaluated policyOutcome. Host does not mint fail/warn.
classes.residual: leftover-design: host must not mint fail/warn

classes.name: host-must-not-mint-d9-or-termination-from-policy
classes.inputVerbatim: A host path that mints a D9 class, exit number, or HostTermination from the pack threshold or from policyOutcome.
classes.passVerbatim: Refused. Host maps only existing D9 v1.14 classes. policyOutcome is not HostTermination.
classes.residual: leftover-design: host must not invent a D9 class or treat policyOutcome as HostTermination

proposedObligations.numberNote: A later MF-6 assigns or remints any DR-G* number. This artifact does not add a row and does not take G24 or any later identifier.
proposedObligations.claim: Host admission of preview analyze requests refuses a non-bundled pack identity and a non-declarative pack or contribution. Corpus is hostile-but-well-formed admission inputs, not crash/malformed failure containment and not provider FactCandidate/Coverage admission (G23).

proposedObligations.numberNote: A later MF-6 assigns or remints any DR-G* number. This artifact does not add a row.
proposedObligations.claim: A missing required TypeScript semantic rung is typed Coverage-indeterminate. Silent syntax fallback fails. Not G21 post-fault Coverage goldens and not G23 Coverage-domain mutation.

proposedObligations.numberNote: A later MF-6 assigns or remints any DR-G* number. This artifact does not add a row and does not restore G17.
proposedObligations.claim: Preview analyze refuses or does not offer SARIF 2.1.0. D-077 drop stands. G17 remains inapplicable and is not this obligation.

proposedObligations.numberNote: A later MF-6 assigns or remints any DR-G* number. This artifact does not add a row.
proposedObligations.claim: A preview terminal result must not be labeled a sealed authoritative Run. No silent promotion. Not G19 durable state-byte class.

proposedObligations.numberNote: A later MF-6 assigns or remints any DR-G* number. This artifact does not add a row. Invents no D9 code.
proposedObligations.claim: The host must not mint fail/warn other than core policyOutcome, and must not mint a D9 class, exit number, or HostTermination from the pack threshold or policyOutcome. Host maps only existing D9 v1.14 classes.
